description: Each rule r1 to r100 repeats the one before it twice, and r0 elides T. So the derivation through r100 elides 2^100 terminators at boundary 0, a count that a 64-bit integer does not hold. A floating-point number holds 2^100 exactly, since it is a power of two, so this case does not catch a floating-point count. The empty alternative elides nothing and wins. Over empty spans the cycle context holds rules only, so the ranking takes time in proportion to the grammar (engine §6).
